replies.author: Timotheeee
replies.body:
Hi, your map looks pretty cool!
I wanted to talk a little about the Overcast network maps selection process. I personally made a TON of maps for overcast network (35+ maps), and I only have 4 loaded in the repository. The thing you have to understand is that OCN is well known for it's very high quality maps. My first map loaded was like my 15th-20th map. The reason is easy to understand, the other maps I was making didn't look any good compared to some in the rotations. In addition to this, most of my XML was broken, so if a mapdev had to be testing it, he would've been in the need to correct it, maybe for a few hours. 
Now, on some maps I've worked for weeks or so, and they were not loaded in the repository, but who cares? I just make maps for fun, not for fame, and this should be the reason for every map maker to make a map.
Now, it's true that getting your map tested is kinda hard on overcast since there is only a few map developpers that are already OVERLOADED with either testing maps or beeing harrassed by players asking them to test their maps. So, yeah, you just have to realize that it's not easy, and move on.
Also, talking about the bias, it's true there is some kind of bias, but not all of the map developpers on Overcast are biased, they just choose the maps they would like to test. 
Overall, the map submission and selection process is all a matter of patience and experience in map making.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Hmm, is that so? Well, i have to say that what your saying isnt entirely correct. If you go to the map sections and see the map dev's comments you'd realize that they mostly comment on "internet famous" peeps maps, even if their maps don't look like much. Same with mods as well. 

Most of the mapdevs on OCN haven't made maps; aside from ElectroidFilms; which makes me wonder how they got their position.

Its still biased if you choose maps that you feel should be tested based on appearance. You're a mapdev, your volunteered role is to comment and help out on maps; no matter how nooby they may be. They're pretty lax with their roles. Their not dedicated to it which has caused multiple threads to call them out on it. 

Avicus mapdevs are more dedicated, every map that comes onto here it is given acute and helpful constructive criticism by the glorious mapdevs here. And unlike OCN, these mapdevs earned their roles through making beautiful and fun maps.

Avicus doesn't have the amount of mapdevs as OCN, really only about 2, but their seriousness in their roles easily trumps OCN's whole mapdev team. Pretty sad for OCN if you ask me.

Now, I'm not a hater or anything. Honestly, I've played OCN before Avicus but from my experience, Avicus is more docile and welcoming to their community. Sure, the players less skilled and more incompetent but their system is more friendlier which makes Avicus my favored server over OCN. 

I really only play OCN for the TNT and RFV3 and etc. But if Avicus were to be introduced to TNT like this map is trying to do, I'd definitely reduce my activeness on OCN down to 25%.

Anyway, I'm glad you like the map Timothee. I just hope it gets accepted and then TNT becomes more widespread in Avicus.

So, I think I need to answer to what you stated here.
NO, they don't "mostly comment on mods/IF's maps", Am I an Internet Famous or a mod on OCN? no. Is rockymine a mod or an IF? and DoomRobotBoy? and how about Beta_Green? no. We probably don't have the same definition of the word "most", I'm sorry.

Now, for the second paragraph, let me tell you you're just completely wrong. Have you even really played on any other server than primed on OCN?
Electroid as you stated indeed made quite a few maps.
Mikeg542 made at least 10-20 maps.
Same for Stealth5061.
dinner1111 has made a lot of maps currently in the rotations and his known for his very well done XML.
ItsMiiOlly made a lot of maps and is very implicated in the arcade stuff. In addition to this, he's the most active map developper on overcast network atm.
Tywnis, well, this is the best example to tell you that you're wrong. This guy made at least 70 maps. So next time, before giving out arguments, you should check your sources.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
*Sigh*... I'm not hating on you ItsMiiOlly, I'm just weary of the methods you OCN mapdevs use to review maps. 

Now I'm not flaming you, I was just stating in my experience. Yeah, I am pretty angry that my maps weren't tested.

But know this, I don't care whether they're accepted or not, I care if they were tested or at least reviewed by the map devs of OCN. 

This also goes to all the other maps from other creators that were left to rot somewhere in the forums. I am not a selfish person, I am an observer and I noticed too many things.

ItsMiiOlly, look through Avicus's Map Releases section. You will notice the way the Avicus mapdevs do their thing. 

They look at the maps, they give structured details of what needs to be added or gotten rid of. And if your map is good, and the YML works, then the map is put into repo for later testing. They themselves often make maps for our enjoyment and are easy to get a hold of and talk. 

Avicus I would say is more... patient and friendlier. 

Now go to OCN map forums and look through. I feel pretty distant with my mother PVP server right now. (As in I learned all my tricks there.)

Notice the difference? 

I'm not hating or flaming, I'm basing it on experience. Yes _IQ really did do that, with you it is a bit of a hassle to get to speak to you since OCN is a big server and I feel guilty bothering you ingame for you to review a map of mine, and the "experimental" maps you have to agree that that is very shady, good they may be, but shady all the same.

I'm not a flamer nor am i butthurt over my maps not getting accepted, I'm just a truthful reviewer who speaks what he sees... and wants his maps as well as others' noticed.

Do you get what I'm now saying? Too many good maps with hundreds of lines of ahotmess.com coding (XML) are getting ignored (Especially with my latest OCN map, Until Dusk... had mob disguises...). And when this happens, you get frustrated and harsh customers like me who don't want to flame but simply wants change. 

Please, you are a nice person. I never had anything against you; just the way y'all review maps... that's all.
